name: a2-bmg-p2
headline: Human Written
windows: A whole leaf can easily end the trip and, in my experience, may keep you from tripping for days afterward. A tiny nibble sometimes smooths psychedelic nausea and even improves the trip without ending it.
But it takes only a little more than a nibble to end the trip, so I use it for nausea only when the person is okay with their trip possibly ending.
